ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 / ScarCruft — Hangul Word Processor (hwp.exe) spawning command-line / script interpreter
ucs.description: Detects ScarCruft's signature initial-access vector against South Korean targets: a weaponized HWP (Hangul Office) document opened by hwp.exe / hshow.exe / hcell.exe that spawns cmd, PowerShell, mshta, regsvr32, rundll32, or wscript/cscript. Hangul Office is a Korean-only word processor — HWP weaponization is a near-unique APT37/Ricochet-Chollima tradecraft fingerprint (also seen with Kimsuky, but the child-process chain into PowerShell + LOLBins is APT37's signature delivery for ROKRAT, CHINOTTO, GOLDBACKDOOR, and M2RAT).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("hwp.exe","hshow.exe","hcell.exe","hword.exe","hpresenter.exe","hwpviewer.exe","Hwp.exe","HShow.exe","HCell.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","msbuild.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | where NOT match(user,"(?i).*\$$")
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("hwp.exe","hshow.exe","hcell.exe","hword.exe","hpresenter.exe","hwpviewer.exe","hncuploader.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","msbuild.exe","installutil.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256 = SHA256,
          IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith @"\hwp.exe"
    or ParentProcessName endswith @"\hshow.exe"
    or ParentProcessName endswith @"\hcell.exe"
    or ParentProcessName endswith @"\hword.exe"
    or ParentProcessName endswith @"\hpresenter.exe"
    or ParentProcessName endswith @"\hwpviewer.exe"
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\cmd.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\powershell.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\pwsh.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\wscript.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\cscript.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\mshta.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\regsvr32.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\rundll32.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\certutil.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\bitsadmin.exe"
| where Account !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 ScarCruft - Hangul Office spawning suspicious child process
id: a6c2f0b1-3a83-4b8e-9c2f-1d1f0a8e23a1
status: experimental
description: Hangul Word Processor (hwp.exe / hshow.exe / hcell.exe) spawning a command-line or script interpreter. APT37 (ScarCruft / Reaper) routinely weaponises HWP documents via OLE objects and EPS exploits against South Korean and Korean-diaspora targets to drop ROKRAT, CHINOTTO, and M2RAT.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/apt37-scarcruft-north-korea
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\hwp.exe'
      - '\hshow.exe'
      - '\hcell.exe'
      - '\hword.exe'
      - '\hpresenter.exe'
      - '\hwpviewer.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\msbuild.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate macros within trusted HWP templates (extremely rare outside Korea)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\hwp.exe OR *\HWP.EXE OR *\Hwp.exe OR *\hshow.exe OR *\HShow.exe OR *\hcell.exe OR *\HCell.exe OR *\hword.exe OR *\HWord.exe OR *\hpresenter.exe OR *\hwpviewer.exe) @Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\msbuild.exe OR *\MSBuild.exe OR *\certutil.exe OR *\CertUtil.exe OR *\bitsadmin.exe OR *\BitsAdmin.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(hwp|hshow|hcell|hword|hpresenter|hwpviewer)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|mshta|regsvr32|rundll32|msbuild|installutil|certutil|bitsadmin|curl)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
| sort(field=_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Hangul Office is Korean-only software with negligible install base outside South Korea — APT37 is the only Tier-1 actor that *consistently* weaponizes HWP as initial access (Kimsuky / APT43 also touch HWP but rarely with this exact LOLBin child set). HWP files cannot legitimately spawn cmd/PowerShell/regsvr32/rundll32 in normal user workflow; that child-process chain only appears when an OLE-objec

_field_issues.message: `IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents. Did you mean `InitiatingProcessTokenElevation`?

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 / ScarCruft — ROKRAT bidirectional cloud-service C2 via pCloud / Yandex / Dropbox / mail.ru APIs
ucs.description: Detects ROKRAT's signature C2 mechanism: a non-sync-client process (PowerShell, rundll32, or a binary running from %ProgramData% / %AppData%\Local\Temp / %Public%) initiating TLS to api.pcloud.com, cloud-api.yandex.net, content.dropboxapi.com, or cloud.mail.ru. ROKRAT (used by APT37/InkySquid since 2017 and active through 2024) is one of very few RATs that uses these four specific cloud providers as a bidirectional channel — the combination of process context + this exact host set is essentially diagnostic of APT37 tradecraft.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_host IN ("api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","api-content.dropboxapi.com","notify.dropboxapi.com","cloud.mail.ru") AND NOT All_Traffic.process_name IN ("pcloud.exe","yandexdisk.exe","yandex.disk.exe","dropbox.exe","dropboxupdate.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","safari.exe","iexplore.exe") by host All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.src_ip All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_host All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.process | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let _approved_cloud_clients = dynamic([
    "pcloud.exe","yandexdisk.exe","yandex.disk.exe","dropbox.exe","dropboxupdate.exe",
    "msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","safari.exe","iexplore.exe",
    "onedrive.exe","teams.exe","outlook.exe"
]);
let _rokrat_c2_hosts = dynamic([
    "api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru",
    "content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","api-content.dropboxapi.com",
    "notify.dropboxapi.com","cloud.mail.ru"
]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (_rokrat_c2_hosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_approved_cloud_clients)
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\")
    or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatorPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          InitiatorName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatorCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatorSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, Protocol
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let _approved_cloud_clients = dynamic([
    "pcloud.exe","yandexdisk.exe","yandex.disk.exe","dropbox.exe","dropboxupdate.exe",
    "msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe",
    "onedrive.exe","teams.exe","outlook.exe"
]);
let _rokrat_c2_hosts = dynamic([
    "api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru",
    "content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","api-content.dropboxapi.com",
    "notify.dropboxapi.com","cloud.mail.ru"
]);
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where (isnotempty(DstHostname) and DstHostname has_any (_rokrat_c2_hosts))
    or (isnotempty(Url) and Url has_any (_rokrat_c2_hosts))
| where isnotempty(ActingProcessName)
| extend _proc = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
| where _proc !in (_approved_cloud_clients)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, DstIpAddr, DstHostname, DstPortNumber, Url, NetworkBytes
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 ScarCruft - ROKRAT cloud-service C2 to pCloud / Yandex / Dropbox / mail.ru
id: 1c3e9d7b-2f4a-4e6d-8b1c-5a7e0d3f9b21
status: experimental
description: Non-sync-client process initiating a network connection to ROKRAT's known C2 cloud-service endpoints (pCloud, Yandex Disk, Dropbox API, mail.ru cloud). APT37 has used this exact set of cloud providers as bidirectional command-and-control for ROKRAT since 2017, including via DOGCALL, CHINOTTO, GOLDBACKDOOR loaders.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0240/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_dest:
    DestinationHostname:
      - 'api.pcloud.com'
      - 'eapi.pcloud.com'
      - 'cloud-api.yandex.net'
      - 'webdav.yandex.ru'
      - 'content.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'api.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'api-content.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'notify.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'cloud.mail.ru'
  filter_legit_clients:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\pcloud.exe'
      - '\yandexdisk.exe'
      - '\yandex.disk.exe'
      - '\dropbox.exe'
      - '\dropboxupdate.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
      - '\onedrive.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
  condition: selection_dest and not filter_legit_clients
falsepositives:
  - Bespoke internal scripts that legitimately use these cloud APIs (allowlist by Image+SHA256)
  - Penetration-testing tooling using the same APIs for exfil testing
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(api.pcloud.com OR eapi.pcloud.com OR cloud-api.yandex.net OR webdav.yandex.ru OR content.dropboxapi.com OR api.dropboxapi.com OR api-content.dropboxapi.com OR notify.dropboxapi.com OR cloud.mail.ru) -@Image:(*\pcloud.exe OR *\PCloud.exe OR *\yandexdisk.exe OR *\YandexDisk.exe OR *\dropbox.exe OR *\Dropbox.exe OR *\DropboxUpdate.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\Brave.exe OR *\opera.exe OR *\Opera.exe OR *\onedrive.exe OR *\OneDrive.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\IExplore.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(api\.pcloud\.com|eapi\.pcloud\.com|cloud-api\.yandex\.net|webdav\.yandex\.ru|content\.dropboxapi\.com|api\.dropboxapi\.com|api-content\.dropboxapi\.com|notify\.dropboxapi\.com|cloud\.mail\.ru)$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(pcloud|yandexdisk|yandex\.disk|dropbox|dropboxupdate|msedge|chrome|firefox|brave|opera|onedrive|iexplore|safari)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, ContextProcessId, DomainName], function=count())
| sort(field=_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: ROKRAT — APT37's flagship implant since 2017 — uniquely uses pCloud, Yandex Disk, Dropbox, and mail.ru as bidirectional C2, both for command retrieval and data exfiltration (T1102.002). Most APTs use compromised infrastructure or commodity hosting; APT37 chose these providers specifically because the API endpoints are TLS-encrypted, geographically diverse, and look like benign cloud-sync traffic t

_sentinel_field_issues.message: `ActingProcessName` is not a column of ImNetworkSession; it does exist on ImProcessCreate, ImFileEvent, ImRegistryEvent.
`ActingProcessCommandLine` is not a column of ImNetworkSession; it does exist on ImProcessCreate, ImFileEvent, ImRegistryEvent.
